svg.text: 03 The JSON diff tool, one of about thirty.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif
Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif
Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: evelopers reach for the same small tools many times a day: diff this

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: JSON, validate it, decode this token, hash that string. Most of the

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: sites offering them quietly upload what you paste.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: json0.dev runs every tool in the browser. Share links keep the whole state in the

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: URL hash, which never reaches a server, and a network guard fails the build if any

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: tool tries to make a request it should not.
